name: Obsidian
author: Maximilian-Maag
description: Wire the Obsidian note app into Omarchy: discover vaults, capture to and open today's daily note, and regenerate the vault CSS snippet from the applied theme so notes follow the desktop palette.

features: Discovers the vaults Obsidian already knows (reads obsidian.json, never guesses)
capture appends text to today's daily note, creating it with a heading when missing
today opens today's daily note via an obsidian:// URI
theme regenerates the vault CSS snippet live from the applied theme's colors.toml — no baked-in palette
Honours the vault's own daily-notes folder/format settings
Uniquely named theme-set hook that self-locates its plugin
